blocks.text: Clayton homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Clayton, October 2026. Detached houses: 34 listed at month end and 5 sold in October, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 99 listed at month end and 17 sold in October, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 41 sold over 5 months against an average of 40.8 listed, about 5.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 113 sold over 5 months against an average of 99.6 listed, about 4.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 29 sold.

faq.a: Surrey. The page covers the Clayton sub-area of Surrey's Cloverdale community; the City plans the ground as Clayton Heights, approximately 809 hectares from Fraser Highway to the ALR, bordered by the Township of Langley in the east — homes east of that municipal boundary are in the Township, not in Surrey Clayton.
faq.q: Is Clayton in Surrey or Langley?

faq.a: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain project names Hillcrest-184 Street Station and Clayton Station (190 Street and Fraser Highway) among its eight stations, and TransLink states an anticipated in-service date of 2029 for the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension from King George Station to Langley City.

At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 34 houses listed with 5 sold in the month and 99 condos and townhomes listed with 17 sold in the month in Clayton. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Clayton?

faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 15%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 17%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
